sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your offer; we appreciate that you secured material forward at fixed prices and understand the importance of planning certainty. Our order volume covers our full demand for this part over the contract term, and our forecast is rising, so the arrangement also offers you a reliable basis for planning. Given the formal approvals involved on your side, would it be helpful if the owner walked us through the calculation, as previously offered?

Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
In our call of 2026-04-21 (doc:20260421-70710-M2) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract and can accommodate the 90-day payment terms you requested.
As we cannot offer a fixed price over a three-year period, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.55 per unit.
We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our offer and making a further move; we appreciate your flexibility on the payment terms and understand your need to manage material volatility. We note your explanation of the cost drivers, though we had hoped the fixed-price material purchases would support a different approach to the surcharge. Our full demand for this part over the term will be with you, and the rising forecast together with the long contract term provides planning security; our proposal moves toward you again.

Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.96 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

In response to your improved offer, we can make a further concession and reduce our price to EUR 5.35 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
